text:
sam: heads-up — I'm oncall tomorrow 08:00–20:00 UTC. Quick preflight: VPN, pager, runbook access, creds. Can folks confirm? I'll hand off any known risk areas.

tara: confirmed you're in the oncall rota. runbooks updated under /docs/oncall/runbooks/oncall-rotation.md. I gave you read + pager send rights.

will: VPN tested for you — use `vpn-client --connect redwood-prod` and MFA via auth app. sample command: 
```
vpn-client --connect redwood-prod
```
works from my laptop. Also make sure `~/.ssh/oncall` has the key.

sarah: pager alert test: i'll trigger a test in 5. Expect SMS + push.

infra-bot: runbook oncall-rotation.md was edited by tara at 2026-03-16 18:12 UTC

sam: got the edit, thanks. tara — do you mind verifying that the KMS key for the oncall creds is accessible? I can't access the secrets UI from my WFH network.

tara: checked — KMS policy includes your user id. If you still can't open UI, use `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://creds.enc` from bastion; ping me before decrypting.

will: paging test sent — please confirm receipt @sam

sam: got push and SMS. ping sound loud enough :thumbsup:

sarah: FYI there's a low-prob risk: nightly jobs might spike latency between 02:00–03:00 UTC; not in your shift but worth noting for morning follow-ups. Logged in runbook under 'known-risks'.

sam: thanks. I'll leave a short handoff note in the channel before I go live. Any additional checks I should run?

tara: quick checklist: 1) run `healthcheck --service router` 2) open grafana dashboard link (https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ops/latency) 3) ensure PagerDuty schedule has you (I moved you in)

sam: ran `healthcheck --service router` — all green. Grafana loads. PD schedule shows me 08:00–20:00 UTC. Thanks everyone.

will: small note — if you need to escalate, use `#incidents` followed by @oncall-sre, and DM me for infra assist.

sam: will do. leaving final handoff: I'm ready. Handing to sam for 08:00 UTC tomorrow. end.
